Subject: Quick ask — hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster

Hi Neha,

We are kicking off a vendor review for hosted inference and I wanted to get Redwood's standard per-1M token rates split by input vs output (we price things that way internally). Can you also send a simple list of the hosted models you expose today (open models + any Redwood tuned variants) and which classes you recommend for high-throughput NLU vs instruction-following chat?

A few context points:
- Use case: document classification + summarization pipeline (mostly short inputs, long outputs for summaries).
- Expected starter volume: ~120M tokens/month; could grow >2B in 6–12 months if latency/cost are good.
- Procurement: we may pursue a committed plan if unit economics are favorable.

If you have a one-page ratecard and a model roster PDF, that would help speed conversations with our procurement team.

Thanks — really appreciate a quick baseline so we can compare options.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Head of ML, MedLytics
Sophie.Martin@medlytics.ai

----Message 2 (reply)----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick ask — hosted API per-1M token rates + model roster

Hi Sophie — great to hear from you, thanks for the context. Attaching a short ratecard and a draft MAP that outlines how we typically structure committed deals. Below is a clean baseline you can share with procurement; we can tailor this once we have expected steady-state commit and latency SLOs.

Baseline hosted (public, non-committed) per 1M tokens — input / output split shown:
- Core (small / cost-optimized models): $4.50 input / $5.00 output per 1M
- Standard (mid-size general-purpose): $12.00 input / $14.00 output per 1M
- Instruction / Chat (fine-tuned for dialogue & complex prompts): $28.00 input / $33.00 output per 1M
- X-Instruction (largest footprints / long context optimized): $55.00 input / $65.00 output per 1M
- Embeddings (per 1M tokens): $3.50 (usually used for vectorization workloads — separate billing)

Notes:
- Rates above are for our hosted API (no reserved commit). Dedicated/private deployments have a different model (flat monthly reserve + throughput pricing).
- We commonly show input / output separately because short prompts + long completions can materially shift economics.
- We provide volume tiers and commit discounts (see bullets below).

Typical commitment discount bands (annualized):
- $10k–$50k/month commit: 10% off listed rates
- $50k–$250k/month commit: 18% off listed rates + 30 days extended trial credits
- >$250k/month commit: 25%–30% off listed rates, multi-region SLA options, and pricing protection windows

Hosted model roster (current public catalog — short descriptions):
- redwood-base-3b (core, low-cost) — good for high-throughput NLU and classification
- redwood-standard-13b (general-purpose) — balanced cost/quality for many pipelines
- redwood-instruct-13b (instruction-tuned) — better for summarization and multi-step instructions
- redwood-chat-70b (chat/instruction large) — high quality for long dialogs and complex summaries
- llm-community/llama2-13b-q8 (quantized) — lower cost option for non-sensitive workloads
- redwood-embed-2 (embeddings) — vectorization model (separate endpoint)

Attachment: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-202611.pdf (one-page baseline)
Attachment: Draft-MAP-MedLytics-001.docx (sample mutual action plan)

A couple of clarifying Qs so we can tailor a proposal:
1) What is your target 95th-pct latency for summary generation? (sub-500ms vs <2s changes instance sizing)
2) Do you need HIPAA / additional compliance coverage for PHI?
3) Any preference for regional residency (we have US and EU hosted regions)

If helpful, I can loop in Ben (pricing/enterprise) and Grace (solutions) on a quick 30-minute call this week to walk through commit scenarios. Available windows: Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
